the final borrowing figure was €28.36 billion higher than the government draft.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The budget concerns the 2023 fiscal year, although the parliamentary decision occurred in November 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect: the budget was adopted by the governing coalition during Olaf Scholz's chancellorship; military procurement was budgeted at €18.7 billion, excluding the €100 billion Bundeswehr special fund.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.10","5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","6B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The enacted budget applies to 2023 and was approved in November 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect: the governing SPD-Green-FDP coalition under Chancellor Olaf Scholz supported the enacted budget; the coalition also approved €10 billion in interest-bearing loans to establish a capital stock intended to stabilize statutory pension contribution rates.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.10","8B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These are provisions for the 2023 budget adopted in November 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect: the measures were adopted by the governing coalition during Scholz's chancellorship; the multi-year commitment authorization was increased by €900 million to €1 billion.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The appropriation was enacted for 2023 and subsequent budget years in November 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect: the measure was adopted by the governing coalition under Chancellor Olaf Scholz;
